description:
Jason Greenblatt was White House special envoy to the Middle East during the first Trump administration. He is a lawyer, author and commentator. Previously, he held various positions at The Trump Organization including executive vice president and chief legal officer.

This journalism is made possible by viewers like you. Donate to FRONTLINE now: https://bit.ly/47DFzCb

And support your local PBS station here: https://www.pbs.org/donate

Greenblatt spoke to FRONTLINE’s Martin Smith on May 28, 2026, for our documentary "The Crown Prince & the President." Watch excerpts from that interview above. They have been edited for length and clarity.

"The Crown Prince & the President" is available to watch here: https://youtu.be/C6gcwTz_85s
